- **Solution 1** quotes 646022962653091240565034693557636043189. Its digit sum is 165, so it is divisible by 3. The congruence a(n) ≡ a(n−2) (mod 3) holds for every term I checked from n=1 through n=8 and for a(18) ≡ a(16) ≡ 0. That requires a(19) ≡ a(17) ≡ 1 (mod 3), since a(17) has digit sum 118. Solution 1's value is ≡ 0 (mod 3), so it fails. Solution 1 admits this failure itself.
- **Solution 3** gives 645631620258023552367430727161372339303, with digit sum 145 ≡ 1 (mod 3). It passes the congruence check. Its growth ratio a(19)/a(18) ≈ 2.67×10³ is also consistent with the neighbouring terms.
